svg.title: YouTube Trending Data Pipeline on AWS
svg.desc: EventBridge starts a Step Functions state machine. An ingestion Lambda pulls trending videos and category mappings from the YouTube Data API into the S3 Bronze bucket, and historical Kaggle files can be backfilled into the same bucket. A Glue PySpark job and a reference-data Lambda build the Silver layer as Parquet. A data-quality Lambda checks Silver through Athena; on pass a Glue job builds three Gold tables that are queried with Athena and QuickSight; on fail SNS sends an alert. The Glue Data Catalog registers the tables of every layer.
svg.text: YouTube Trending Data Pipeline on AWS
Serverless medallion lakehouse on Amazon S3 · Lambda · Glue (PySpark) · Athena · orchestrated by Step Functions
